# NES Game engine

> This project is under active development. Features, internal APIs, and
> project structure may change as development progresses.

A lightweight NES game engine written in 6502 Assembly using the cc65 toolchain.

The goal of this project is to provide a small, modular foundation for NES game development, handling common hardware-related tasks and providing reusable game systems while keeping the underlying hardware accessible to the developer.

Rather than hiding the NES hardware behind high-level abstractions, this engine provides reusable routines and building blocks that make game development easier while retaining control over the hardware and memory.

## Features

- iNES header and cartridge configuration
- Reset and NMI handlers
- Controller input handling
- OAM DMA transfers
- Palette loading
- Nametable loading
- Sprite and metasprite rendering
- Timer system
- Tile-based collision detection
- Modular source code and build system

A simple demo is included where the player can be moved using the D-pad, with
basic collision detection.

![NES Demo](docs/images/nesdemo.gif)

## Requirements

- [cc65](https://cc65.github.io/)
- [GNU Make](https://www.gnu.org/software/make/)
- [GNU Bash](https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/) or a POSIX-compatible shell for running `configure` and project scripts
- [Lua](https://www.lua.org) - required only for optional tools.

## Build

```
make
```

Build artifacts are saved in the **builds/** directory.

### Make commands

- `make` - build ROM;
- `make run` - build and run in emulator;
- `make clean` - deletes build artifacts and **builds/** directory;
- `make simulate` - not used currently in this project, emulate 6502 assembler program;
- `make map` - output memory map.

### Make variables and defaults

- `TARGET ?= main` file name of NES ROM output.
- `SRC_DIR ?= src` source files directory.
- `BUILD_DIR ?= build` directory where NES ROM output and compiled object are
  saved.
- `CA65  ?= ca65`  - 6502 Compiler.
- `LD65  ?= ld65`  - 6502 Linker.
- `SIM65 ?= sim65` - 6502 Simulator (not used in this project).
- `SIM_SRC ?= `    - 6502 Simulator input file (not used in this project).
- `DEBUG=1`        - Enables simple break points support, like:
  ```asm
    @debug:
      JMP @debug
  ```

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── core/       Hardware abstraction and low-level NES functionality
├── game/       Game-specific logic
├── gfx/        Graphics and rendering routines
├── include/    Shared constants, macros, and definitions
└── main.s      Main game loop

assets/         CHR graphics and other binary assets
└── patterns.chr

builds/         Build output
```
